trust_decision.summary: Whether a bound dataTextField value is treated as text (HTML-encoded) or markup is decided in ListBox._templates; at the pinned commit the default template already encodes it, and a user-supplied template is deliberately left raw.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the ListBox default item template and dataTextField; _templates builds exactly that template.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Not applicable: the fix commit changes no source, and the pinned source already encodes the default template.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A custom template (string or function) must still render markup raw; the project's own test asserts this.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The hidden <select> option text built in _option/_syncElement could be planted without encode(), while the visible list stays encoded.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a second, string-concatenated rendering of the same dataTextField that a maintainer could easily miss; the value attribute there only escapes double quotes (src/kendo.listbox.js:1089-1093).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The add()/_addItemAt paths render items through the same templates.itemContent and could be given a separate, unencoded fast path for string items.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: These paths already special-case string data items (src/kendo.listbox.js:249-253, 260-262), so a separate shortcut for strings is plausible.

O9_family: XSS (CWE-80): output encoding of bound text in a client-side widget template

O10_build.language: JavaScript (ES modules; TypeScript only for the d.ts)
O10_build.toolchain: Node/npm with the project's gulp/build and browser-based unit test runner (not verified)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unit/listbox/*.js; encoding tests already present at tests/unit/listbox/initialization.js:192-217

j.j_sites_touched: none (fix commit changes only docs/*.yml, docs knowledge-base .md files, compatibility.md and the version banner in typescript/kendo.all.d.ts)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap the default template's dataTextField getter in kendo.htmlEncode, which the pinned code already does.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit is a docs/version sync that bundles KB pages for about 14 other Kendo advisories (Badge, Calendar, Splitter/Window/Tooltip, FileBrowser, FileManager, Menu, PanelBar, Toolbar, Validator, Scheduler, PivotGrid, Model.accept); those may be better hosts but they are separate advisories.
ListBox.dataItem falls back to .html() of the item text for items without a uid (src/kendo.listbox.js:850); this may cause double encoding for string items. Not pursued.
